verdict.rationale: Superhuman is an AI email client with its own agents, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can act as an MCP client; the axis applies. The pack documents only the opposite role: Superhuman Mail MCP is a server that exposes the inbox to Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants, which cannot be credited here. The mentions of agents using "the work you connect" and admin "connector permissions" never say users can plug in arbitrary MCP servers, so there is no evidence of MCP-client capability.
